latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Feishu Backup skill.
- Allows users to back up files from Feishu group chats to a local backup directory.
- Supports smart matching with multiple filters: file amount, filename prefix/keyword, file type (pdf/image/video), and recent time ranges.
- Activated by user requests such as "back up the PDF I just sent to Feishu".
- Downloads files only via `feishu_backup.sh`, with strict verification of successful output.
- Provides clear feedback in case of backup errors or failed downloads.
